projects.title: Launch a small business
projects.prompt: Help me launch a small homewares business. I need a clear offer, a simple website and a realistic launch plan. Keep the first launch small and affordable.

criteria.text: Create and test a simple website

projects.title: Plan a weekend away
projects.prompt: Plan a relaxed weekend away with a fixed budget, two route options and a final itinerary.

projects.title: Learn something new
projects.prompt: Help me learn the basics of photography through short practical exercises.

nodes.title: A small, considered launch
nodes.detail: The original goal: a clear offer, a working website and a practical plan.
nodes.next: Finish the website checks before choosing a launch date.

nodes.title: One collection, three products
nodes.detail: Keep the initial offer small and explain what makes it useful.
nodes.evidence: Example evidence: approved one-page offer brief (fictional).
nodes.rationale: A smaller range is easier to explain and fulfil.
nodes.alternatives: Launch the full range; open with preorders.
nodes.consequence: Other products remain parked until after the first launch.

nodes.title: Build the first website
nodes.detail: The first draft is ready. Check the mobile layout and product information.
nodes.next: Test the draft on a phone and record the result.

nodes.title: Product photos
nodes.detail: The draft still uses placeholder product images.
nodes.next: Photograph the three products in consistent light.

nodes.title: Set the launch date
nodes.detail: Choose the date after the site and photographs are ready.
nodes.next: Review readiness after the website checks.

nodes.title: A seasonal subscription?
nodes.detail: An interesting offshoot for later. It is outside this first launch.
nodes.next: Revisit after feedback from the first collection.

nodes.title: Choose coast or countryside
nodes.detail: Compare two routes against the same budget.
nodes.next: Compare accommodation and total travel time.
nodes.alternatives: Coast: more driving. Countryside: more walking.

nodes.title: Practise light and framing
nodes.detail: Try the first short photography exercise.
nodes.next: Take five photographs of the same subject from different angles.

events.text: Chose a three-product collection and recorded the tradeoff.
Compared two weekend routes; budget check is next.
Saved the first website draft. Mobile checks remain open.
Parked the subscription idea as a separate branch.
